name: EXM_PERSON_CUM_MILEAGE
description: This table contains expenses usage information for a person such as cumulative distance traveled within a specific period.

columns.name: PERSON_CUM_MILEAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a person cumulative mileage.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person associated with the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment associated with the row.

columns.name: VEHICLE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Grouping of vehicle types such as company, private, or rental.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description: Types of vehicles for which mileage reimbursement is permitted such as car, motorcycle, or van.

columns.name: FUEL_TYPE
columns.description: Types of fuel for which fuel charge reimbursement is permitted.

columns.name: DISTANCE
columns.description: Distance traveled passed the threshold.

columns.name: DISTANCE_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Unit of the distance traveled, such as kilometer or mile.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the mileage accumulation starts.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the mileage accumulation ends.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount to be reimbursed for the cumulative mileage.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the currency of the reimbursement.
